review.authorization_runtime_scope_assessment: The orchestrator validates authorization scope against the contract runtime fields (runtime_python_executable, runtime_freeze_sha256, runtime_qualification_sha256) before validate_runtime and before any actor spawn. Any drift raises RuntimeError and fails closed. The authorization scope also binds the 96 tasks, mode=e1, K=8, initial skill, resolved model, identity SHA, max_turns/output tokens, and provider budget.
review.checkpoint_resume_assessment: Resume is missing-only via completed_streams.jsonl, with revalidation of completed stream and rollout SHAs before resume. Claims from ambiguous crashed calls are conservatively consumed and never reset. The ledger is bound to the exact contract/authorization pair, so cross-contract reuse is impossible. No counter-reset path exists.
review.failed_v2_contamination_assessment: The failure adjudication is a pre-provider technical failure: 0 provider claims, 0 completed streams, 0 trajectory refs, 0 updater calls, no support inspection, and the stale lock is preserved. The failed V2 root is not retryable and V2.1 uses a fresh run root. No scientific outcome was observed, so no outcome selection is possible or needed. This permits a fresh contract.
review.model_identity_assessment: Fresh V2.1 qualification binds deepseek-v4-pro to deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813 and kimi-k3 to kimi-k3 with retry=0 and thinking disabled. The actor scientific path uses DeepSeek and fails on resolved-model drift via the required_resolved_model check in ArkPlanReactLLM and the actor runner's authorization scope check.
nonblocking_notes: The actor runner's ReactAgentFactory uses sys.executable for python_path; this is safe only because the orchestrator launches the actor with the venv python. Any future direct invocation of the actor runner outside the orchestrator would need its own runtime guard.

The runtime qualification artifact lists python_executable as /usr/bin/python3.12, but validate_runtime correctly requires the venv/bin/python and checks the qualification venv_root and freeze SHA, not the qualification's own python_executable field.
review.provider_budget_preservation_assessment: The SQLite provider budget ledger is unchanged from V2: transactional claim before provider I/O, exact contract+authorization binding, 10-call per-rollout ceiling, 7680 global ceiling, claims never released, budget provenance in receipts/trajectory refs, and resume validation. The 11th and 7681st pre-I/O blocks remain tested. The runtime repair did not touch the ledger or its tests.
review.runtime_binding_assessment: validate_runtime requires the exact venv root, exact venv/bin/python, freeze SHA, qualification SHA/status, and a fresh import smoke before any actor spawn. The orchestrator builds the actor subprocess command with the contract-bound runtime_python and passes runtime_env with VIRTUAL_ENV and PATH bound to the venv. The actor runner itself uses sys.executable only for the ReactAgentFactory python_path, which is the venv python because the subprocess was launched with it. No ambient /usr/bin/python3 path remains for the actor/provider path.
review.runtime_freeze_and_import_assessment: The bound runtime is the previously qualified E0/MindMemOS runtime: mindmemos-eval-venv, freeze SHA ed0e582bdd2ac7bac376d4287b3d38e6e3bf28a522016c14891b4f037635044e, qualification SHA 38a1614b049ed328165c85584017ae8f48340afea9cf247bb1dd20958265ef9b. The zero-provider smoke requires pydantic, openpyxl==3.1.5, ReactAgentFactory, and SpreadsheetBenchEnv imports. The freeze file contains pydantic 2.13.4 and openpyxl 3.1.5. No ambient Python can execute the actor/provider path because the orchestrator only spawns with the venv python and the actor runner's load_mindmemos imports happen inside that subprocess.
review.single_sentence_verdict: V2.1 is a clean fresh contract with explicit frozen-runtime binding that preserves the previously reviewed fail-closed provider budget and support design, and no P0/P1 blocker remains to separately mint the E1-A authorization.
review.support_gate_and_selection_assessment: The support gate is unchanged: mixed>=24/96, >=8/12 streams each >=2 mixed, supported families >=4, no replacement/dropping, no rounding/waiver. The support adjudicator recomputes per-stream and per-family mixed counts directly from all 96 frozen K8 pools and does not grant E1-B. The runtime repair did not alter tasks, K, model, or thresholds.
review.updater_separation_assessment: E1-A remains pool generation/support only. The orchestrator and support adjudicator contain no updater or learned-skill evaluation path. updater_calls is hard-required to be 0. Even support PASS only permits preparation of a separate E1-B contract, with execute_e1_b false.
